Moment_captions.HAVING_COFFEE: Kɔfe brɛoo bi ne asomdwoe mmerɛ ne me kwan pa a mede hyɛ da ase.
Moment_captions.WALKING_MY_DOG: Me kraman ma me nnam, ɔma mifi krow mma m'ani gye kyɛn sɛnea ɛfata me.
Moment_captions.WORKING_OUT_AT_THE_GYM: Mepɛ sɛ meho yɛ nnam na menya mmerɛ a mede bɛma meho ayɛ den na mayɛ kanyan.
Moment_captions.COOKING_DINNER: M'anigye fie aduane nnoa ho, sɛ mesɔ nnuane foforo hwɛ, na meyɛ biribi firi mfiase.
Moment_captions.BAKING: Paanoo toɔ ne me mfatoho pa a mede twentwɛn me nan ase yɛ biribi a ɛyɛ dɛ.
Moment_captions.READING_A_BOOK: Ma me nwoma pa bi ne baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn, na mɛtumi ayera mfhyehyɛ mmerɛ pii.
Moment_captions.WATCHING_A_MOVIE: Sini pa bi ne nnuane nketenkete, na anwummere a m'ahome te — eyi deɛ boro biribiara so.
Moment_captions.PLAYING_VIDEO_GAMES: M'anigye sɛ meyera wɔ agorɔ pa bi mu berɛ a mewɔ mmerɛ ma me ho nkoaa.
Moment_captions.PLAYING_BOARD_GAMES: Mepɛ nkontabuo nketenkete akansie, titiriw berɛ a nnamfo pa ka ho.
Moment_captions.OUT_WITH_FRIENDS: Me mmerɛ pa bi ne anwummere a me ne nnamfo pa sere bɔ mmo.
Moment_captions.HAVING_BRUNCH: Aduane pa, kɔfe pa, na baabiara nni hɔ a merepɛ ntɛm — ɛno ne me kwandabre weekend.
Moment_captions.DINING_OUT: M'anigye sɛ mehunu mbeae foforo, mesɔ nnuane foforo hwɛ, na mehunu nneɛma a ɛsie.
Moment_captions.HIKING: Me koraa ani gye wɔ abɔnten, sɛ merehwehwɛ akwan foforo mu na mafiri daa nneyɛe mu.
Moment_captions.GOING_FOR_A_RUN: Mirika mmirika ma me adwene mu tew, meho yɛ nnam, na m'ani gye abɔnten mmerɛ ho.
Moment_captions.CYCLING: Mepɛ sɛ mesian me taseɛnam so, mehunu mbeae foforo, na m'ani gye kwan no ho.
Moment_captions.AT_THE_BEACH: Ma me awia kɛseɛ bi, ɛpo no, ne mmerɛ kakra na m'ani gye.
Moment_captions.WATCHING_THE_SUNSET: Awia kɔtɔee fɛfɛɛfɛ bi deɛ, m'ani nnyɛ kyee sɛ mɛgyina ahwɛ, baabiara a mɛwɔ.
Moment_captions.ON_VACATION: Mepɛ sɛ mehunu mbeae foforo, mesɔ nneɛma foforo hwɛ, na manya nkaedi wɔ kwan no so.
Moment_captions.ROAD_TRIP: Nnwom pa, akwantempɔn, agyinae a ɛyɛ anigye, na nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ — me ho nhyehyɛe.
Moment_captions.CAMPING: Sɛ mifi dede mu na mekɔtena abɔnten ne nneɛma a m'ani gye ho kɛse.
Moment_captions.TAKING_PHOTOS: M'anigye sɛ mehu mmerɛ nketenkete na mefa nneɛma a ɛfata nkaedi.
Moment_captions.MAKING_ART: Sɛ mede me nsa bɛyɛ biribi foforo ne kwan pa a mede gye m'ahome.
Moment_captions.PLAYING_MUSIC: Nnwom daa bɛka me bra ho, sɛ mɛtie oo anaasɛ mɛbɔ oo.
Moment_captions.DANCING: Mepɛ nnwom pa, ahoɔden pa, ne mfatoho biara a mede bɛsa.
Moment_captions.SHOPPING: M'anigye sɛ mehwehwɛ mbeae foforo mu, mehunu nneɛma foforo, na mmerɛ bi mu no metɔ biribi ma meho.
Moment_captions.VOLUNTEERING: Mepɛ sɛ mede me mmerɛ bi yɛ biribi a mfasoɔ wɔ so ma nkurɔfo foforo.
Moment_captions.STUDYING: Daa mereyɛ biribi foforo ho adwuma na m'ani gye suadeɛ ho wɔ kwan no so.
Moment_captions.WORKING: Mesi me mmanim adwuma so, nanso megye di sɛ asetena boro adwuma nkoaa so.
Moment_captions.RELAXING_AT_HOME: Mmerɛ bi anwummere pa ne sɛ mɛtena fie, madum biribiara, na m'ani gye asomdwoe mmerɛ ho.
Moment_captions.TRYING_SOMETHING_NEW: Mepɛ sɛ mema asetena yɛ anigye na maka 'aane' ama nneɛma a mnyɛɛ bi da.

Rules.title: Ahyɛdeɛ ne Mpanyinsem
Rules.subtitle: Yɛsrɛ wo, gye yɛn amanamfoɔ ahyɛdeɛ tom ansa na woafiri nnamfofoɔ hwehwɛ ase.
Rules.respect_title: Yɛ Nipa Pa na Di Obu
Rules.respect_desc: Didiatwɛm, nitan kasa, ahunahuna, anaa asɛm mmoni biara bɛma yɛatwa w'adwuma mu ntɛmara a yɛnnan yɛn akyi.
Rules.media_desc: Moment biara a wobɛkyɛ no, ɛwɔ sɛ ɛde wo mfonini anaa wo video tiawa ankasa ba. Nokorɛyɛ mapa ne biribi panyin a ɛda saa platform yi adi.
Rules.moment_desc: Wobɛtumi ayɛ Moments ama ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa (public) anaa nipa a wone bɔn fapem pɛ (matches). Nanso, ansa na wobɛtumi de match request akɔma obi no, gye sɛ wowɔ public moment baako pɛ mpo.
Rules.safety_desc: Mma nipa a woahyia no foforɔ biara wo password, wo sika ho nsem (banking info), anaa wo fie address da.
